summary.ru: Перемышльская земля — одна из исторических земель Галицко-Волынского княжества с центром в городе Перемышле, позднее, в 1340—1772 годах Русского воеводства Королевства Польского. Исторический центр Червонной Руси.
summary.en: The Principality of Peremyshl was a medieval principality centered on Peremyshl, and encompassing the Przemyśl Land, in the historical region of Red Rus'. It was one of several minor principalities within Halychyna, situated in the most western part of the region, and thus bordering the medieval Polish state. From the 11th and up to the 13th century, Peremyshl was ruled mostly by local princes from collateral branches of the Riurikid dynasty, but on several occasions it also came under influence of neighboring Polish or Hungarian rulers. By the 14th century, the region came under firm Polish control.
